questions.prompt: When life speeds up and turns turbulent, how does your attention naturally respond?

options.label: I slow down deliberately to inspect the terrain
I lean into the storm with rapid decisive action
I seek an anchor of silence and pause completely
I drift with the current until clarity emerges

questions.prompt: Where do you instinctively place your anchor when ground feels shaky?

options.label: In the breath and physical sensation of the body
In timeless texts and perennial philosophy
In creative solitude and journaling
In honest conversation with a trusted friend

questions.prompt: Which quality of support helps you endure protracted uncertainty?

options.label: Firm structure, discipline, and daily routine
Gentle non-judgmental acceptance of difficulty
Humor and lighthearted perspective
Quiet shared presence without spoken advice

questions.prompt: How does inquiry show up when you face an obstacle?

options.label: As a sharp razor dissecting cause from consequence
As a broad river seeking alternative pathways
As quiet wonder asking what this experience reveals
As patience, waiting for the dust to settle before deciding

questions.prompt: What does genuine restoration look like in your life?

options.label: Deep dreamless sleep and physiological surrender
Walking in open forest, river, or sky
Deep immersion in art, music, or poetry
Total digital disconnection and sacred silence

questions.prompt: When you look back on a past ordeal, what gave it lasting value?

options.label: Discovering a depth of courage I didn't know I had
Deepening my compassion for other beings who suffer
Realizing that my worth is not tied to outcomes
Finding an unshakeable quiet that remains through all storm
